purpose: Playable battle loop contract for Hollow Wretch and Gateborn Colossus behavior records, AI intent selection, telegraphed counterplay, reaction windows, objective pressure, and telemetry.
runtimeRules: Enemy actions must be selected from creature role / AI archetype and combatRole, not a generic strike table.
Every major Wretch and Colossus behavior must expose readable telegraph copy before damage or objective denial resolves.
Reaction windows must present DODGE, PARRY, or COUNTER_CHARGE counterplay with Momentum costs before consequences land.
Gateborn Colossus can pressure objectives through OBJECTIVE_CRUSH, but progress loss is capped and logged.
Hollow Wretch pack pressure must become more dangerous with multiple living Wretches, but remains counterable through movement, Dodge, and Guardian mitigation.
Mission scaling uses capped tactical budgets; difficulty comes from behavior, threat budget, and counterplay before raw stat inflation.
uiRequirements: Battle cards show creature profile labels such as HOLLOW_SWARMER and GATEBORN_BRUTE.
Battle cards show intent labels, behavior tags, reaction type, threat budget, and counterplay copy when an intent is active.
Battle log records ENEMY_INTENT, REACTION_OPENED, OBJECTIVE_CRUSH, FRACTURE_ROAR, and reaction resolution events.
qualityGates: TG-DEV-008 Hollow Wretch produces SWARM_RAKE and SWARM_SURROUND intents under deterministic setup.
TG-DEV-008 Gateborn Colossus produces GATE_STOMP, FRACTURE_ROAR, and OBJECTIVE_CRUSH intents under deterministic setup.
TG-DEV-008 reaction windows open with readable counterplay and Momentum costs.
TG-DEV-008 playable battle UI exposes behavior tags, threat budgets, and counterplay text.
TG-DEV-008 runtime telemetry records enemyIntentCounts, enemyBehaviorTags, enemyCounterplay, and objective denial effects.
